## Docs checklist ([standard](../docs/DOCS_STANDARD.md))

- [ ] Component README updated (summary, run, test, interfaces, rationale, gaps, status)
- [ ] Public items have doc comments; `cargo doc` builds clean
- [ ] Interface change? Owner and consumer docs, ARCHITECTURE.md and fixture updated
- [ ] New decision? Row appended to your stream's section of docs/DECISIONS.md with the next `SIM-`/`DATA-`/`APP-`/`DOC-` ID
- [ ] docs/ROADMAP.md Status and Gantt tag updated for features touched
- [ ] New doc listed in docs/README.md
